te: Work of the debt, dairy and integrated rice subcommittees followed up
se: The meeting noted that the farm household debt subcommittee is preparing its report, the dairy subcommittee is preparing a draft study report on the draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. ...., and the integrated rice subcommittee has set the framework of its report, covering rice costs, yields, quality and marketing
it: Progress of the subcommittees (farm household debt · dairy cattle · integrated rice)

te: Drought (part 6): the Geo-Informatics and Space Technology Development Agency (GISTDA) gives information
se: The meeting considered approaches to solving drought problems systematically and invited the Geo-Informatics and Space Technology Development Agency (GISTDA) to give information on the use of satellite images and a drought monitoring platform, including an application that helps identify drought-risk areas in advance down to subdistrict level, piloted in some provinces
it: Approaches to solving drought problems systematically

te: Drought (part 5): the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation gives information
se: The meeting considered approaches to solving drought problems systematically and invited the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation to give information on the care of watershed forests, reforestation, building check dams, and short-, medium- and long-term plans for areas with repeated drought and flooding
it: Approaches to solving drought problems systematically

te: Drought (part 4): the Royal Forest Department and the Department of Mineral Resources give information
se: The meeting considered approaches to solving drought problems systematically and invited the Royal Forest Department and the Department of Mineral Resources to give information on restoring watershed forests to hold water, community forests, check dams, and the management of water and geological hazards
it: Approaches to solving drought problems systematically

te: Drought (part 3): the Department of Royal Rainmaking and Agricultural Aviation and the Land Development Department give information
se: The meeting considered approaches to solving drought problems systematically and invited the Department of Royal Rainmaking and Agricultural Aviation and the Land Development Department to give information on the royal rainmaking operation plan, related research, and soil and water management projects in drought-risk areas
it: Approaches to solving drought problems systematically

te: Drought (part 2): the Office of the National Water Resources, the Hydro-Informatics Institute and the Royal Irrigation Department give information
se: The meeting considered approaches to solving drought problems systematically and invited the Office of the National Water Resources, the Hydro-Informatics Institute and the Royal Irrigation Department to give information on the water resources master plan, drought and flood prevention plans for 22 river basins, dry-season measures, water allocation and the water situation in the main dams
it: Approaches to solving drought problems systematically

te: Drought (part 1): the Thai Meteorological Department and the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation give information
se: The meeting considered approaches to solving drought problems systematically and invited the Thai Meteorological Department and the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation to give information. They expect rainfall in the May–October 2025 rainy season to be mostly near or above normal, except on the eastern side of the South, and described preparations for drought. The meeting also noted the progress of the subcommittees and ended its consideration of the matter of using an access road on irrigation project land
it: Approaches to solving drought problems systematically

te: Subcommittee's study visit to the Pak Phanang basin noted
se: The meeting noted the progress of the subcommittees, such as water management information from Regional Irrigation Office 15 and the results of the study visit to Nakhon Si Thammarat and Phatthalung Provinces on whole-system water management and livelihood development in the Pak Phanang river basin
it: Progress of the subcommittees, and results of the Pak Phanang basin study visit

te: Subcommittee work on the Pak Phanang basin and the draft Dairy Cattle Act followed up
se: The meeting noted that the farm household debt subcommittee is studying the management of the royally initiated Pak Phanang River Basin Development Project, and that the dairy subcommittee gave observations on the draft sections on the make-up of the Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Board. It also noted the price index of major crops and agricultural news
it: Progress of the subcommittees: the Pak Phanang basin and the draft dairy law
Price index of major crops, and agricultural news

te: Agencies heard on foreign nominees in agricultural businesses in the East
se: The meeting invited the Department of Agricultural Extension, the Royal Irrigation Department and the Governors of Chachoengsao, Rayong and Chanthaburi Provinces to give information on measures to monitor landholding and agricultural businesses, such as fruit packing houses (lhong), run by foreigners through nominees. The committee is concerned that this could make Thai farmers lose bargaining power, and recommended that state agencies monitor the issue proactively. It also noted the progress of 3 subcommittees
it: Landholding and agricultural businesses by foreigners through nominees
Progress of the subcommittees (farm household debt · dairy cattle · integrated rice)

te: The Ombudsman's recommendations on nominee landholding followed up, and a rice subcommittee set up
se: The meeting noted the Ombudsman's decision and recommendations on foreigners holding land through nominees, and felt that the Department of Agricultural Extension, the Royal Irrigation Department and the Governors of Chachoengsao, Rayong and Chanthaburi Provinces should be invited to give information. It noted the progress of the farmer debt and dairy subcommittees, and considered setting up a subcommittee to study and develop an integrated rice system
it: The Ombudsman's recommendations on foreigners holding land through nominees
Progress of the farm household debt and dairy subcommittees
Subcommittee to study and develop an integrated rice system set up

te: Petitions on a Bang Saphan rubber office, rice farmers and farmland received
se: The meeting noted progress on petitions, such as the aromatic coconut crisis in Ban Phaeo, Samut Sakhon Province, a road in Lamphun Province and low fish prices in Phuket, and considered new matters, such as speeding up the setting up of a Bang Saphan branch of the Rubber Authority of Thailand, proposals to strengthen rice farmers and the competitiveness of Thai rice, a request to use national forest reserve land in the Bang Saphan cooperative settlement, and rights to apply for land title deeds in Na Yong District, Trang Province
it: Progress on petitions: Ban Phaeo aromatic coconuts · a road in Lamphun · fish prices in Phuket
Speeding up the setting up of the Bang Saphan branch of the Rubber Authority of Thailand
Proposals to strengthen rice farmers and the competitiveness of Thai rice
Farmland: forest reserve land in the Bang Saphan cooperative settlement, and land title deeds in Na Yong District

te: Subcommittee set up to study the draft Dairy Cattle Act; petitions on blackchin tilapia, cattle disease and sugarcane received
se: As assigned, the meeting studied the draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. ...., which the House of Representatives has accepted in principle (Senate Rules of Procedure, rule 119), and resolved to set up a subcommittee to study it. It also considered petitions, such as blackchin tilapia, bovine respiratory disease complex, problems delivering sugarcane to mills, registration of foreign workers in agriculture, and the Phang Nga Provincial Farmers Council's 5-part proposals
it: Study of the draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. ....
Petitions: blackchin tilapia · cattle disease · delivering sugarcane to mills · foreign workers in agriculture
Policy proposals of the Phang Nga Provincial Farmers Council (water, land, small-scale fisheries, produce collection points, crop switching)

te: The Japan visit followed up; petitions on a Phuket fishing pier, a floodgate and organic farming received
se: The meeting noted preparations for bilateral meetings and a visit to Japan, and considered petitions, such as an objection to turning part of the fishing pier of the Fish Marketing Organization in Phuket Province into a tourist pier, a request for a water gate on Khlong Rong Khua to ease flooding and drought, and a request for help with problems in organic farming
it: Bilateral meetings and visit to Japan
Petitions: the Phuket Fish Marketing Organization pier · the Khlong Rong Khua water gate · organic farming

te: 7 petitions received, from a reservoir to the draft fisheries law
se: The meeting noted the fisheries subcommittee's progress on the project to take fishing boats out of the system, and considered petitions, such as following up the Mae Tai La reservoir project in Phrao District, Chiang Mai Province, the crisis facing beef cattle farmers, a cattle disease outbreak in Trang Province, hardship caused by blackchin tilapia in Chanthaburi, and proposals both supporting and raising concerns about section 69 of the draft law amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance
it: Progress of the fisheries subcommittee: the project to take fishing boats out of the system
Petitions: the Mae Tai La reservoir · beef cattle farmers · cattle disease · blackchin tilapia
Proposals and concerns about section 69 of the draft Act amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance

te: A request for fair treatment from shellfish farmers in Surat Thani followed up, and a foreign visit prepared
se: The meeting followed up a request from a group of long-standing shellfish farmers in Mueang Surat Thani District for fair treatment in the allocation of farming areas. The Department of Fisheries explained that the provincial fisheries committee sets controlled aquaculture zones under section 77 of the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015), and that farmers who feel this is unfair may appeal to the district chief who issued the order. The meeting also considered the draft schedule of bilateral meetings and foreign visits for fiscal year 2025
it: Request for fair treatment over the allocation of shellfish farming areas, Mueang Surat Thani District
Draft schedule of bilateral meetings and foreign visits, fiscal year 2025
